The '''Hermit language''' is a [[Critically endangered language|critically endangered]] [[West Manus languages|West Manus language]] formerly spoken on [[Hermit Islands|Hermit]], [[Luf Island|Luf]] and [[Maron Island]]s in western [[Manus Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. It has been replaced by [[Seimat language|Seimat]].
